desc: Run a matmul + ReLU ONNX model with ONNX Runtime on each selected target's execution provider (CPU, CUDA, OpenVINO on the Intel NPU or GPU, CoreML, MIGraphX), with CPU fallback disabled; compare with NumPy and record the provider, latency and GFLOPS.
